data.body:
RCA re-confirmed at origin/main 286ab4f5ee2 before fixing (evidence-first, fast path):

1. NOT merged-commit: _referencing_commit_exists (src/rebar/_commands/transition_close.py:149) runs ['git','-C',repo_root,'log','--format=%B%x00'] with NO ref argument (:160-163) — it scans the entire history reachable from the worktree's current HEAD. Merge status is never consulted; an unlanded local commit with a 'rebar-ticket:' trailer or leading '<id>:' subject satisfies it (:167-173 via extract_ticket_refs + resolve_ticket_id).
2. CONDITIONAL, not unconditional: the referencing-commit check fires only when the ticket records file_impact (transition_close.py:286-288); _completion_precheck also returns early for session_log/code_review/identity types (:217-218), when require_completion_verification_for_close is off (:227-234), on --force-close (:235-236), and on a live duplicate/supersedes replacement link (:256-257).
3. SUBTREE, not one id: accepted_ids credits the ticket plus every transitive descendant from list_descendants across epics/stories/tasks/bugs buckets (:278-285).
4. --ref exists and is undocumented in AGENTS.md: src/rebar/_cli/help/transition.txt:7 and docs/plan-review-gate.md:954 §'Which commit the completion gate verifies — --ref' document it; grep -c -- '--ref' AGENTS.md is 0. Note --ref retargets only the completion verification/signature tree; it does NOT narrow the referencing-commit scan (git log still runs with no ref).

Population: AGENTS.md close-precheck bullet (currently lines 239-246 on main — drifted from the plan's 235-242) and CONTRIBUTING.md §2f (currently ~250-260; the false phrase wraps as 'requires the\nmerged' across lines 254-255, so the single-line AC grep already misses it — the content fix still applies). Legitimacy: defect (docs contradict the implementation, which is the authoritative source). Fix is docs-only; no behavioral change needed — the land-before-close ordering is correctly enforced by policy (Verified +1 rule), not by the precheck. Proceeding per the signed plan.
